findings.claim: The initial rollover regression hardcoded a 17px row height instead of measuring the browser substrate.
findings.evidence: The cross-family choice audit found the environment-sensitive oracle; the committed test measures getBoundingClientRect().height and passes 10/10.
findings.path: rendered scrollback row -> measured height -> expected scroll delta

findings.claim: Waiting only for a rendered terminal row allowed the fixture greeting to race direct core mutation and add one unrelated discarded row.
findings.evidence: Exact head a2b2de1 failed 5303 versus 5320, exactly one row; __wterm is exposed before shell attach and greeting. Waiting for the greeting produced 15/15 serial and 10/10 focused rollover.
findings.path: WTerm.init debug exposure -> shell attach -> greeting write -> direct E2E mutation

findings.claim: Disabling native browser anchoring breaks resize anchoring.
findings.evidence: The test had captured the old virtualized window before its scheduled RAF. Waiting for the render preserved the logical row and passed 10/10 focused plus 15/15 serial.
findings.path: scrollTop assignment -> scroll event -> scheduled render -> first-visible observation
